dct_title_s: Saxoniae superioris circulus : ob oculos sistens. Ducatum et electoratum saxtoniae marchionatum misniae, landgraviatum thuringiae, principatum anhaltinum, schwarzenburg, hallensem comitat, mansfeld, voitland, &c. cum aliis insertis et adjacentibus Provinciis accura te delineatus / per Matth. Seutter S.C.M.G. Augustanum.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Date partially based on printing privilege given in 1741 by Karl VI, as shown by text at bottom of map: "Cum gratia et privil. S. R. I. Vicariat[us], in partib[us] Rheni, Sveriae, et Juris Franconici".; Manuscript "43" at top right corner of sheet.; Vignette in upper right corner around title shows gods and goddesses: Minerva, with helmet, spear, and shield, with books nearby; Juno, with crown, scepter, and cornucopia; Mercury, with winged helmet and caduceus; Mars, with helmet, shield, and short sword, surrounded by cannonballs, guns, and a flag. Another cornucopia sits in the lower left corner of the map, above the scale.
